shortcut_cycleCapitalization: Cycle the capitalization of the selected word
shortcut_endNextCaption: Extend selection to the end of the next caption
shortcut_endNextComma: Move selection to the next word ending in a comma
shortcut_endNextSentence: Extend selection to the end of the next sentence
shortcut_endNextTranscriptBreak: Extend selection to the next paragraph break
shortcut_mergeFollowing: Merge the following word into the selected word
shortcut_seekToSelection: Seek playback to the selected word
shortcut_selectCurrentWord: Move selection to the current word
shortcut_startPrevCaption: Move selection to the start of the previous caption
shortcut_startPrevSentence: Move selection to the start of the previous sentence
shortcut_startPrevTranscriptBreak: Move selection to the previous paragraph break
shortcut_toggleCaptionBreak: Toggle a caption break at the selection
shortcut_toggleTranscriptBreak: Toggle a paragraph break at the selection
